## strings and regex

```{r}
string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "jeff")

str_detect(string_vec, "jeff") #basically command F with more control
str_detect(string_vec, "My")
str_detect(string_vec, "my")

str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "^i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "i think$")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "[Pp]umpkin") #either capital or lowercase is true
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[") #if you want to look for the bracket itself, use  \\
```

## quick note on factors

```{r}
vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))

as.numeric(vec_sex) #places it into its levels

vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male") #releveling categories

as.numeric(vec_sex)
```




##Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)
```

pull the tables out

```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> #gets all tables in html
  first() |> #takes first table
  slice(-1) #removes rows not wanted
```
